feedback: The increased wheel track to 0.18 and moving the rear sensors further back to y = -0.03 helped the controller by providing earlier line detection and improved lateral stability, as intended. However, the robot still fails early with one line loss event per run and off-track termination around 10% progress, indicating the controller needs to respond more aggressively to early line deviations. The controller had to compensate for the wider wheel track by increasing steering gains to maintain responsiveness. The rear sensors' influence was slightly reduced in weight to avoid oversteering from early detection. To improve further, the geometry should continue to support early turn detection and stability but allow the controller to maintain better control at higher speeds.
requested_changes: sensor_positions: move rear sensors slightly further back to y = -0.035 to detect turns even earlier
sensor_size: keep at 0.016 for noise robustness
